Mr. Pallone demanded the yeas and nays and the Chair postponed further proceedings until a time to be announced.
The previous question was ordered pursuant to the rule.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H.J. Res. 75.

dimensions.assessment: Affects commercial refrigeration equipment manufacturers, commercial businesses utilizing refrigeration units, and consumers impacted by equipment costs and energy efficiency.
dimensions.evidence: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Commercial Refrigerators, Freezers, and Refrigerator-Freezers

dimensions.assessment: Relieves commercial equipment manufacturers from complying with more stringent energy efficiency standards previously scheduled for 2029.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state specific federal spending or revenue changes resulting from the disapproval of the rule.
Nullifies a specific regulatory action by the Department of Energy's Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy under the Congressional Review Act.
dimensions.evidence: Congress disapproves the rule submitted by the Office of the Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy... and such rule shall have no force or effect

dimensions.assessment: Permanently prevents the specific rule from taking effect or having any force or effect.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

Alternative timelines or plans for future energy conservation standards for commercial refrigeration.
importance_detail.rationale: H.J.Res. 75 uses the Congressional Review Act to nullify a Department of Energy rule establishing new energy conservation standards for commercial refrigerators, freezers, and refrigerator-freezers.
